caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a light brown background and a thin, darker brown border. Inside the rectangle, there are two large, identical circular patterns positioned side by side, each containing a series of evenly spaced radial segments emanating from a central circle, all rendered in light beige and medium brown tones. Above and between these two circles, there is a single dark brown, four-lobed cloud-like shape with a beige outline, containing five small beige dots inside. A darker wavy line runs along the inner border of the rectangle, with matching "S"-shaped motifs on both the left and right sides near the centers of the circles. The overall image uses a limited palette of brown, beige, and cream colors, and all elements are geometrically symmetrical and evenly spaced.
title: Painted Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
